name: Mystery EP1
detailed_description:
The phone rings. The voice on the other end is filled with desperation. Something terrible has happened, and now it’s up to you to uncover the truth. Mystery is a 2D platformer in pixel art, where exploration and interaction are essential to unravel a mystery hidden in the darkness.

Step into the shoes of an investigator and immerse yourself in an atmosphere heavy with tension, where every detail might hold a crucial clue. Traverse mystery-rich environments, from silent hallways to unknown basements, as you search for answers hidden in objects, documents, and markings left behind.

🕵️‍♂️ Key Features:

  • 2D pixel art platformer, with a detailed and nostalgic visual style.

  • Free exploration, allowing you to investigate every corner of the mansion and beyond.

  • Interaction with objects, examining clues that reveal hidden secrets.

  • A dense atmosphere of suspense, enhanced by an immersive soundtrack.

  • Puzzles and challenges, testing your ability to connect the fragments of the story.

Silence can be just as unsettling as the unknown. Are you ready to discover what lurks in the shadows?
